exposure: gestational age at birth (early term vs. full term)
outcome: Hospital admission during the first year of life
cohort: 2,845 children (545 early term-born and 2,300 full term-born) aged 1 to 10 years old
finding: Early term-born children had significantly increased respiratory morbidity and use of health care services compared with full term-born children, even when stratified by mode of delivery and family history of atopy.
mod_finding: Increased rates of respiratory symptoms in early term-born children persisted when delivery by means of cesarean sections were included in logistic regression models.
gest_age: Early term: 37-38 weeks, Full term: 39-42 weeks
